component.name: WireGuard GUI
component.summary: WireGuard クライアントの GUI

description.p: A desktop client for managing WireGuard profiles on Linux. Import, edit and delete profiles, connect and disconnect, and optionally encrypt stored profiles at rest behind a 4-digit PIN.
用于管理 Linux 上 WireGuard 配置的桌面客户端。支持导入、编辑与删除配置， 连接和断开，并可选择用 4 位 PIN 码对本地配置进行静态加密。
Connections are handled through NetworkManager when it is available, and fall back to wg-quick otherwise.
Adds RPM, arm64 snap and Flatpak packaging.
Adds multi-language support and localized desktop metadata.
